name: Restrict Admin Login by Country – GRC
author: Robert G.

sections.description:
Restrict Admin Login by Country – GRC protects your WordPress dashboard from unauthorized brute-force and credential stuffing attacks by filtering access according to the visitor’s geographic location.

Designed for optimal performance, offline capabilities, and high reliability, this plugin doesn’t require manual account creation or secret keys to fetch geolocation files.

Key Features

  • Local Geolocation Engine: Uses the MaxMind GeoLite2-Country database for lightning-fast offline lookups.
  • Automated Mirror Updates: Automatically downloads and updates the .mmdb database file via secure public mirrors without requiring a MaxMind account key.
  • Smart Rate Limiting: Checks and updates the local database just once every 24 hours to prevent excessive server load.
  • API Fallbacks: Built-in seamless fail-safes (ip-api.com and ipinfo.io) ensure you are never locked out if local files are missing.
  • IP Caching: Caches individual IP lookups for 30 days to optimize login speed.
  • Built-in ISO Country List: Static, comprehensive country mapping ensures high performance without hitting external translation APIs.
  • Anti-Lockout Protection: Automatically detects the installer’s home country during activation and permanently permits it, protecting you from accidental lockouts.
  • Targeted Role Protection: Specifically restricts elevated roles (administrator, editor, author, shop_manager) while leaving normal subscribers or site visitors unaffected.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/restrict-admin-login-by-country-grc directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Upon activation, the plugin automatically creates a secure directory in /wp-content/uploads/advanced-country-blocker/ and downloads the latest GeoLite2 database mirror.
  4. Navigate to Settings > Country Login Blocker to verify your setup, review your automatic database status, and manage allowed countries.
sections.faq:
Will I get locked out of my website?

No. During activation, the plugin automatically detects your current IP country and locks it into your allowed list. You can never accidentally block yourself.

What happens if the GeoIP database is unavailable?

The plugin features automatic fallback mechanisms. If the local database file is missing or encounters an error, it seamlessly queries safe external APIs (ip-api.com / ipinfo.io) before allowing or denying access.

How often is the database updated?

The automated background scheduler verifies and refreshes your database file once every 24 hours (rate-limited) to keep records accurate without performance impact.
sections.changelog:
2.2.0

  • Added automated jsDelivr / WP Statistics mirror database downloading (GeoLite2-Country.mmdb.gz).
  • Removed the need for manual MaxMind account key setup.
  • Optimized rate-limited background checks to execute once every 24 hours.

2.1.0

  • Introduced local MaxMind lookup engine support.
  • Integrated static ISO-3166-1 country array.
  • Added 30-day transient IP caching and robust multi-tier API fallbacks.

2.0.0

  • Initial rewritten OOP-structured release with enhanced security and cleaner codebase.

short_description: Blocks unauthorized role logins from restricted countries using local MaxMind databases with automatic mirror updates or remote API fail-safes.
